title: Three Runways and a Sea Route
body:
I’ve extended the playable map north through Highwall Pass into Alder Reach. To the east, I can cross the Cedar Passage Bridge to Gullstone Island or sail from Patchport to Eastmere. South Bay, Alder Reach and Eastmere all have working runways.

At either port I can order the crane to move a numbered container between the yard and the ship. The freighter waits for the crane, sails on my order and can resume a saved crossing. I’d like to put those crossings on an automatic schedule next.

images.alt: The in-game Quartz County map shows the Patchport–Eastmere sea route and five airfields, including Sable Cay and Opaline Key.
A paved road climbs through Highwall Pass between steep rock faces.
Cedar Passage Bridge crosses Quartz Sound toward Gullstone Island.
The Q-180 flies out over Quartz Sound with Cedar Passage Bridge below.
